correctness.rationale: For finite posets each element of an upset lies below one of its maximal points, hence same-frontier subneighbourhoods preserve intersections with all upset witnesses. Minimal elements in each frontier fibre therefore suffice for all tests. Conversely, scoping to any upset U and supplying singleton upset witnesses at its maximal ambient points detects exactly whether the fibre has a member below U. These threshold tests of arity at most the number of ambient maxima identify the unique minimal antichain of each fibre. Counting is a bijection between tuples of antichains and semantic equivalence classes. Verified independently by exhaustive local full-signature enumeration of all labelled orders up to three worlds; symbolic proof holds for every finite poset.

value.rationale: Positive persistent semantics naturally restricts valuations to upsets, creating an observable-information loss absent from Boolean powerset semantics. The theorem provides a sharp intrinsic description of precisely that loss and a full enumeration of inequivalent local operators on any finite poset, with chain, discrete and Dedekind-number star profiles. These canonical operations are useful for finite semantics and model comparison, not an arbitrary slice of unrelated finite data. No global model classification is claimed.
